title: The Butler Did It
synopsis: A royal spoon goes missing and everyone assumes Peppermint Butler took it, which is fair, but this time he actually didn't.
plot:
The Candy Kingdom's ceremonial Spoon of Office vanishes the night before the Sugar Festival. Given Peppermint Butler's well-documented history with dark magic and things going missing, the Banana Guards arrest him immediately. Peppermint Butler is deeply offended, not because he is being accused, but because the theft is so sloppy. If he had done it, no one would have noticed the spoon was gone.

Princess Bubblegum reluctantly lets Finn and Jake investigate with Peppermint Butler in tow, in handcuffs made of licorice. He walks them through the castle like a detective, pointing out that the display case was opened from the inside and that the culprit left a trail of crumbs that are, unmistakably, Starchy.

Starchy confesses: he took the spoon because he was certain it was bugged by the government, and he is the government, so he wanted to check. Peppermint Butler is released and immediately asks for a formal apology, which Bubblegum gives. Later that night, alone, Peppermint Butler polishes a small collection of spoons in the Under-Cellar. The Spoon of Office is not among them. Probably.
transcriptText:
Banana Guard: The spoon's gone! The spoon's gone!
Princess Bubblegum: Which spoon?
Banana Guard: THE spoon!
Princess Bubblegum: [sighing] Bring me Peppermint Butler.
Peppermint Butler: Your Highness, I am wounded. Wounded.
Princess Bubblegum: Pep, you have stolen from this castle eleven times.
Peppermint Butler: Twelve. And not once did you notice for at least a month. This? This is amateur hour.
Finn: So you didn't do it?
Peppermint Butler: If I had done it, we would not be having this conversation. We would be having tea.
Jake: That's... kind of a good point.
Princess Bubblegum: Fine. Finn, Jake, take him with you. In the cuffs.
Peppermint Butler: Licorice. Charming.
[The display room.]
Peppermint Butler: Observe. The case latch was opened from within. So the thief was inside the case.
Finn: How does someone get inside the case?
Peppermint Butler: One is placed there, as a decoration, and waits. Note the crumbs.
Jake: Those are potato crumbs.
Peppermint Butler: Those are Starchy crumbs.
Starchy: [from a vent] I HEARD THAT.
Finn: Starchy! Why'd you take the spoon?
Starchy: It's got a listening device in it! The government put it there!
Princess Bubblegum: Starchy, you work for the government.
Starchy: Exactly! So I'd know!
Peppermint Butler: I believe an apology is customary.
Princess Bubblegum: [through her teeth] I'm sorry, Peppermint Butler.
Peppermint Butler: Thank you, Princess. I shall treasure it.
[Night. The Under-Cellar. Peppermint Butler polishes a row of spoons by candlelight.]
Peppermint Butler: [to himself] Amateur hour.
